use_when: Qualify an open-ended DM answer with AI before sending a booking link.
avoid_when: Use 6025 for a simple explicit answer; avoid AI classification for consequential eligibility decisions.

required_facts: DM keyword, qualification rubric, not-yet path, booking link and human owner.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
